correctness.rationale: Exact two-step conservation on connected cycles forces complementary binary firing phases for every genuine primitive two-cycle; all local chip intervals are derived both ways. The four-state mass transfer matrix has characteristic polynomial (λ+z)(λ+z²)(λ²-(z+z²)λ-z³), proving exact all-n coefficients and correct temporal-orbit division by two. Nonnegative chip holdings and n>=3 endpoints are covered. Complement conjugacy proves reciprocity; analyticity and dominance of z r_+(z) near z=1 prove the Gaussian CLT with first logarithmic derivative 3/2 and second sqrt(2)/8. VERIFY.py independently brute-tests 349504 states n=3..9 using actual initial configurations; no finite-only extrapolation.

originality.rationale: The principal source Dall'Asta, arXiv:cond-mat/0601267v1, explicitly classifies temporal modes and describes W=1 two-site building blocks (page 3), but its counting formula on page 4 applies to critical energy and longer period configurations, not a closed mass-resolved all-density primitive-two-cycle enumerator or its Gaussian mass law. Jiang 1003.0943 studies allowable periods and the nontrivial-period boundedness lemma on general graphs, not this cycle microcanonical enumeration. Searches of published mathematical records and general literature found no stronger claim implying the present single polynomial. Originality risk: the 2006 block classification could yield a separate equivalent enumeration, and an unindexed historical explicit formula cannot be excluded.
residual_risks: Dall'Asta 2006 W=1 two-site block classification is close and could hide an equivalent mass-enumeration corollary; main novelty rests on obtaining explicit closed polynomial and Gaussian law, not period classification.
An inaccessible or unindexed exact energy-refined count may preexist.

value.rationale: Conserved mass is the natural microcanonical control parameter for deterministic fixed-energy sandpile rings. The exact coefficient-generating polynomial counts all initially primitive two-cycle orbits separately at each admissible energy, rather than only their possible periods or special critical densities. The reciprocal mass spectrum, exact edges and nontrivial Gaussian fluctuation constant are meaningful physical/mathematical information not furnished by the established period-mode classification. The cycle-closure effect distinguishes this claim from previous path and ladder counts.
